llms.body:
# LiveAgent

> LiveAgent is help desk and call center software for small and growing support teams, in business since 2004: email, live chat, phone, social media and a knowledge base in one shared inbox, with AI that answers customers and drafts replies. Prices start at $15 per agent a month billed annually ($19 billed monthly) for email, live chat and knowledge base; call center and social channels start with the Team plan at $29 ($35). 30-day free trial, no credit card required.

LiveAgent is also available in 19 other languages, each on its own domain: www.live-agent.cz, www.liveagent.dk, www.liveagent.de, www.liveagent.es, www.liveagent.fr, www.live-agent.it, www.liveagent.hu, www.live-agent.nl, www.live-agent.pl, www.liveagent.ro, www.liveagent.sk, www.live-agent.cn, www.liveagent.ph, www.liveagent.vn, www.liveagent.ae, www.liveagent.com.br, www.liveagent.jp, www.live-agent.se, www.live-agent.fi.

Plans and prices, as the pricing page shows them:

- Starter: $15 per agent/month billed annually, or $19 billed monthly. Per agent, up to 5 agents. Email ticketing and contact forms; Live chat and chatbot; Knowledge base; All AI features; Single sign-on (SSO). No social channels, call center or reporting.
- Team: $29 per agent/month billed annually, or $35 billed monthly. Per agent, up to 15 agents. Everything in Starter; Facebook, Instagram, X, Viber, WhatsApp, Telegram; Call center; Reporting, CSAT surveys and time reporting; SLA rules and custom roles.
- Business: $49 per agent/month billed annually, or $59 billed monthly. Per agent, any team size. Everything in Team; MCP server: connect your own AI tools to LiveAgent; LiveAgent branding removal; Audit log and department roles.
- Enterprise: $3,199 per month billed annually, flat fee, or $3,999 billed monthly. 80 agents included. Everything in Business; Unlimited departments, channels, rules and roles; Dedicated account manager; Priority support and review calls; Custom billing and release management.

These are the regular prices. A time-limited offer, when one runs, is shown on the pricing page (https://www.liveagent.com/pricing/) next to them, with its last day.

## Overview


- [LiveAgent: Help Desk Software with AI Agents and Live Chat](https://www.liveagent.com/): Overview of LiveAgent: help desk, live chat, ticketing and call center in one platform.

- [Features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/): Index of all LiveAgent features across channels, automation, AI and reporting.

- [Integrations](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/): Directory of integrations, plugins and apps that connect LiveAgent to other tools.

- [Success stories](https://www.liveagent.com/success-stories/): Customer case studies showing how companies use LiveAgent for support.

- [Migration to LiveAgent](https://www.liveagent.com/migration/): How to move from another help desk to LiveAgent, including data migration.

## Pricing


- [Pricing](https://www.liveagent.com/pricing/): Plans and prices, with a 30-day free trial and no credit card required.

- [Start your free trial today](https://www.liveagent.com/trial/): Sign up for the 30-day free trial.

- [Book a LiveAgent demo](https://www.liveagent.com/demo/): Book a live demo of LiveAgent.

## Products


- [Help desk software with AI agents](https://www.liveagent.com/help-desk-software/): Help desk with built-in live chat and AI for replies, tagging and routing.

- [Website Live Chat Software with an AI Chatbot](https://www.liveagent.com/live-chat-software/): Website live chat widget with AI agents, automation, mobile apps and reporting.

- [Ticketing system and software for support teams](https://www.liveagent.com/ticketing-software/): Ticketing with AI-drafted replies, tagging, spam detection and routing.

- [Call center software](https://www.liveagent.com/call-center-software/): Call center with VoIP, IVR, call routing and omnichannel support.

- [Customer portal features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/customer-portal/): Self-service portal with ticket tracking and a knowledge base.

- [AI Chatbot for Customer Support](https://www.liveagent.com/ai-chatbot/): AI Chatbot trained on your own data, working inside live chat.

## AI


- [AI customer service software and AI agents](https://www.liveagent.com/ai-customer-service-software/): LiveAgent's AI for customer service: AI agents for chat, tickets and phone, AI Answer Assistant, what AI costs and how other tools bill AI.

- [AI Autoresponder](https://www.liveagent.com/features/ai-autoresponder/): AI Autoresponder: sends instant, personalized replies to incoming requests.

- [AI Agents for Every Department](https://www.liveagent.com/features/ai-agent-departments/): Assign an AI agent to a department to pick up unassigned tickets.

- [LiveAgent AI Ticket Summary](https://www.liveagent.com/features/ai-ticket-summary/): Turns long ticket conversations into short structured summaries.

- [AI Spam & Irrelevance Filter](https://www.liveagent.com/features/ai-spam-and-irrelevance-filter/): Detects and filters spam and irrelevant tickets before agents see them.

- [Connect AI tools to LiveAgent with MCP](https://www.liveagent.com/features/mcp-server/): Connects Claude Desktop and other MCP tools to search and manage tickets.

## Key features


- [Universal inbox features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/universal-inbox/): One dashboard for email, calls, social media and chat.

- [Call center features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/call-center-overview/): Call center features: call distribution, recording and transfers.

- [IVR (Interactive Voice Response) features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/ivr-interactive-voice-response/): Customizable IVR menus to route calls and cut wait times.

- [Knowledge Base features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/knowledge-base/): Customizable knowledge base with articles, forums and feedback boards.

- [Customer portal features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/customer-portal/): Customer portal with knowledge base, feedback forum and ticket submission.

- [Service Level Agreement (SLA) Features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/service-level-agreement-sla/): Set SLA targets and track response and resolution times.

- [Automated Ticket Distribution](https://www.liveagent.com/features/automated-ticket-distribution/): Assigns tickets to agents automatically by predefined rules.

- [Automation Rules](https://www.liveagent.com/features/rules/): Automation rules for transfers, tagging and resolving tickets.

- [Video call features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/video-chat/): Browser-based video calls with customers.

- [Multilingual support features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/multilingual-support/): Support customers in their own language, with customizable language widgets.

- [Customer service reports features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/customer-service-reports/): Reports on team performance, departments and areas to improve.

- [Time tracking features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/time-tracking/): Track time spent on tickets and ticket resolution times.

- [Tags features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/tags/): Organize tickets with tags, added manually or by rules, and use them in reports.

- [API features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/api/): API for integrating LiveAgent with other software.

- [iOS App for Customer Support](https://www.liveagent.com/features/ios/): Native iOS app to answer, transfer and resolve tickets.

- [Android App for Customer Support](https://www.liveagent.com/features/android/): Native Android app with chat, tickets and push notifications.

## Security


- [Single Sign-On (SSO) for Secure Multi-System Access](https://www.liveagent.com/features/single-sign-on/): Single sign-on through Microsoft, Google, Facebook or Okta.

- [Help Desk Security features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/help-desk-security/): Security features: IP bans, 2-step verification and HTTPS encryption.

- [Multiple data centers features](https://www.liveagent.com/features/multiple-data-centers/): Choose your data center region at signup.

- [GDPR-Compliant Live Chat & Help Desk, EU Hosting](https://www.liveagent.com/gdpr/): How LiveAgent protects personal data and privacy under the GDPR.

- [Security privacy policy](https://www.liveagent.com/security-privacy-policy/): Security and privacy policy: GDPR, 2FA, HTTPS and DDoS protection.

## Integrations


- [Slack](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/slack/): Slack notifications for ticket updates, via native or Zapier setup.

- [Shopify](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/shopify/): Shopify: live chat, phone support and customer order data in LiveAgent.

- [WhatsApp](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/whatsapp/): Manage WhatsApp conversations as tickets in LiveAgent.

- [Facebook](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/facebook/): Manage Facebook inquiries, posts and comments from LiveAgent.

- [Instagram](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/instagram/): Handle Instagram messages in the unified inbox.

- [Viber](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/viber/): Turn Viber messages into LiveAgent tickets.

- [Salesforce](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/salesforce/): Create Salesforce cases from tickets and track customer information.

- [HubSpot](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/hubspot/): Manage HubSpot contacts from LiveAgent, with triggers and actions.

- [Zapier](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/zapier/): Connect LiveAgent to other apps without code through Zapier.

- [WordPress](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/wordpress/): Add LiveAgent live chat to a WordPress site with the plugin.

- [WooCommerce](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/woocommerce/): Connect a WooCommerce store to LiveAgent.

- [Magento 2](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/magento/): Load customer info and orders from Magento 2 into LiveAgent.

- [PipeDrive](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/pipedrive/): Connect Pipedrive CRM leads and communications with LiveAgent.

- [Jira](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/jira/): Link LiveAgent tickets to Jira issues, natively or through Zapier.

- [Mailchimp](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/mailchimp/): Manage Mailchimp subscriptions from LiveAgent.

- [Gmail Integration](https://www.liveagent.com/integrations/gmail/): Handle Gmail messages in a multi-user LiveAgent dashboard.

- [Best Intercom Alternative - LiveAgent](https://www.liveagent.com/intercom-alternative/): Comparison of Intercom alternatives, including LiveAgent.

- [Top 10 Best Help Scout Alternatives for 2026](https://www.liveagent.com/blog/help-scout-alternative/): LiveAgent compared with Help Scout.

- [Hubspot Service Hub Alternative - Best Solution](https://www.liveagent.com/hubspot-service-hub-alternative/): Comparison of HubSpot Service Hub alternatives, including LiveAgent.

What LiveAgent does for your support team

One tool for the work a small support team does every day, from the first message to the solved ticket, with 200+ integrations for tools like Shopify, Slack and HubSpot.

  • Too many customer messages?

    Help desk software

    Manage email, chat, calls and social messages in one inbox, with rules that assign, tag and remind.

  • Losing track of support requests?

    Ticketing

    Every message becomes a ticket with its history, so you can track each request until it is solved.

  • Customers messaging you on social media?

    Social media

    Answer Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and X messages from the same inbox as email and chat.

  • Visitors expect instant answers?

    Live chat

    Chat with website visitors in real time, see what they type before they send it, and let the AI chatbot answer after hours.

  • Customers asking the same questions?

    Knowledge base

    Publish help articles and FAQs so customers find answers themselves, and the AI answers from the same articles.

  • Managing phone support separately?

    Built-in call center

    Take calls in the help desk with phone menus, call routing and recording, on your own phone provider and numbers.

LiveAgent is cloud help desk software: every customer message, from email, live chat, phone or social media, becomes a ticket your team can assign, answer and track, with a knowledge base and AI agents to help.
